column3: All primes p>3 and the specific polynomial square modulo p^7 require a uniform p-adic identity, not checking small primes. No telescoping certificate identified; primary claimed-resolution body not inspected. Status gives no clearance.

For every n and all n subsets, the literal 6sqrt(n) bound is Spencer's theorem, already attributed in the statement. Reproving its entropy argument is not discovery; primary proof body not inspected here.
Every finite faithful symplectic action for all n>=2 entails lattice classification and discriminant-length control. No small uniform certificate; 2026 source body and resolution scope unchecked.

Arbitrary alpha and integer N require definitions of e1,e2, endpoint regularization and N=0 convention. They are absent from the literal integral. No full angular-evaluation mechanism established; source body unread.
Literal text is a descriptive paragraph with no quantified Hales-Jewett assertion. Cannot manufacture alphabet/color/dimension quantifiers or count a classical theorem as discovery.

For all simple G,H, equal involution counts allegedly force equal orders; statement itself reports a source counterexample. Need actual groups and counting proof before mathematical exclusion is audited. No novel witness route pursued.

Universal convergence for every initialization could be refuted by one exact iteration matrix with spectral radius>1 under A3=I and strongly convex first quadratics. Need precise penalty/update conventions and KKT feasibility; primary 2026 body unread, so no new counterexample claim.

All complex alpha, formal F, all r and h require formal-residue substitution and invariant coordinate z/(2-z). This is a short classical involution-invariant-series mechanism; likely source theorem. No source-body or new-literature clearance, so no credit for rederiving it.

All five integer inequalities constrain k-connected graphs with exact independence number and near-k-regular edge count. Lower degree-sum bound is immediate; uniform extremal construction is the hard part. No mechanism covering all parity/connectivity cases.

Literal Kelvin/Weaire-Phelan description gives no admissible partition or precise optimality quantifier. Full equal-volume spatial variational problem has no bounded-certificate route here; do not reinterpret a title as a theorem.

Every m>w>0 needs actual admissibility constraints defining I(m,w). The exponential cap-set consequence does not supply those constraints or a constructive family. Primary body unread; no finite sample promotion.

Every eigenvalue j and all real alpha require uniqueness and nondegeneracy beyond the reported low/high-j ranges. An intermediate finite spectral check still needs rigorous spectral enclosures and a uniform large-j theorem dependency; not low-burden screening.

All connected decomposable graphs except H0 require a global 3-edge-color mechanism or an exact four-color obstruction outside H0. Cactus instances and the previously accepted edge-irregulator family are different invariants and yield no bridge. No new full-scope mechanism.

Every decomposable graph of maximum degree 3 requires compatible locally-irregular edge decompositions. Exhausting a bounded order cannot prove the statement; no reducible-configuration argument covering all subcubic graphs supplied.

For every fixed k>=5 an eventual Delta threshold is asserted; literal statement says survey completely resolves it. Need actual resolved directions and girth-5 counterexamples/thresholds, not a fresh proof of a retired survey question. Primary body unchecked.

For every d<1, positivity of random-code capacity requires nonzero asymptotic rate, not finite simulations. Need precise random coding ensemble and a full rate lower bound surviving d approaching 1; none identified.

All maps and all colorings for all d,r go beyond a prime-r parameter result. Continuity/affinity is not specified in literal map quantifier; arbitrary-map corrections earn no credit. Primary definitions and topological dependencies unresolved.

For every finite group the spread-one equivalence has an easy necessary quotient obstruction, but the converse is stated settled in 2021. Primary Burness-Guralnick-Harper proof body not read; no new discovery eligibility inferred.

Minimal anticanonical volume for every n>=2 requires comparison with all exceptional klt Fano n-folds, not merely the constructed family or fixed-dimensional enumeration. Heavy birational boundedness dependencies; no exact global comparison route.

One universal forest-cover constant for all noncrossing single-touch shortest-path systems needs a planar structural decomposition without a common boundary face. No finite configuration or uniform coloring mechanism covers arbitrary nesting here.

All n>=2 require optimal lower bound 2n-3 against arbitrary biased independent lazy transpositions. Support-size and entropy counts alone do not force this sharp linear length; no rank or induction invariant established.

Primary v1 definitions 47,49,50 and Conjecture53 read; v2 removes this discussion. With usual 0<1 lex order, a prefix starting 10 cannot be rotation-minimal, so counts and Euler transform are zero and the recurrence is vacuous. This is a convention/wording issue, not a substantive full-scope discovery.

For each c0>=0 choose epsilon in [1/2,1) and c uniformly over all graphs. In particular c0=0 demands eventual chromatic-choosable behavior. Small graphs do not decide an adjustable additive threshold; no family or structural proof supplied.

At most 13 sticks is finite in stick count but not obviously finite in unbounded lattice coordinates. Literal wording mixes simple hexagonal and cubic lattices. Need source-correct lattice and complete normal form plus knot certification; a lattice wording repair earns no credit.

Primary normalized-Laplacian derivative formula, averaged repeated eigenspaces, Theorem2.19 proof opening and Conjecture2.20 read. Published upper bound 2-lambda settles lambda>=1, not low eigenvalues; no bound1 bridge for lambda<1 obtained. No exhaustive successor clearance or proof dependency audit.

For every abelian G,m, restricted sumset minimum must meet min(rho,2m-2-|L|). Small groups may be enumerable but torsion and subgroup effects are unbounded. Need a uniform structural restricted-sumset argument; |L| may be infinite in literal statement, so domain also needs checking.

All k>=3, all epsilon>0 and sufficiently large divisible dense k-graphs require an absorption/decomposition theorem. k=3 or explicit cycles are only instances. No short full-scope extension from known low uniformity.

All doubly stochastic matrices and normalized weight matrices require expected optimal matching comparison. Weight sign/domain and optional unmatched edges need primary definitions. Uniform weights are one feasible point, not a convexity proof of minimum under the coupled constraint.

All bounded convex Euclidean domains and convex potentials is the classical fundamental-gap theorem, explicitly attributed to Andrews-Clutterbuck 2011. No credit for formalizing or reproducing it; full two-point maximum-principle body not read here.
One c>0 uniform over all isolate-free graphs is already stated proved with c=10^-4. Exact witness computation cannot supply novelty; Ferber-Krivelevich primary proof body unchecked.

All levels n>=1 of a real cyclotomic unit tower require an exact trace minimum and uniform attainment, with nearest-integer c_n. Testing small levels is only an instance; no lower bound controlling all relative units identified.

For all q>=3 and t>=3 the minimum degree among Ramsey-minimal graphs must be monotone. Signal-sender methods are only a possible tool; no construction turning every extremizer into the required comparison without changing degrees.

Quantifiers involve connectivity, minimum degree and a longest outside path, but two parameter symbols are corrupted Greekmath strings. Guessing their intended names cannot certify source fidelity. Long-cycle structural proof not supplied; no credit for repairing text.

Source v2 Conjecture1.5 matches all finite posets, nonempty A, 2<=k<=n-1. Author survey LEsurvey11 p25 footnote4 already gives C3+C1 with A the two maxima. Independent exact enumeration gives position counts (1,1,2,0), violating log-concavity at k=2. Public source contains full witness, so no discovery credit.

Each fixed kth largest loop has a probabilistic n^(alpha+o(1)) size with high probability. KPZ prediction is not a proof; finite meander enumeration cannot control the asymptotic exponent. No rigorous scaling-limit transfer identified.

For every n>=6, all arithmetical structures on two graph families must obey an exact doubly-exponential maximum. The recurrence only supplies a candidate extremizer. Need a global Diophantine extremal argument and star/complete correspondence, not fixed-n enumeration.

One absolute d must bound all recoloring diameters by dn^2 for every allowed k,D. Requires connectivity and a uniform recoloring schedule for acyclic color classes, not only proper graph coloring; degree parameter and update definitions unverified.

Primary v2 p2 explicitly says Theorem1.4 confirms Conjecture1.2. Exact full-quantifier bridge: n>=6 implies (10n+1)/(17n)<=61/102<3/5. Local conclusion proof read at section2.4, full discharging dependency chain not independently replayed. Routine published outcome earns zero.

For every minimum-degree-2 graph, ceiling(n/2) is stronger than the published 10n/17+1/17. Source Conjecture1.3 read and no reduction closing the coefficient gap found. No claim of current unresolved status from sparse searches.

Universal additive C at coefficient1/2 cannot follow from coefficient10/17 as n grows. Source Conjecture3.3 and discussion links this to near-equivalent half-bound; no uniform improvement mechanism. Constant-size experiments cannot settle all n.

Every genus-one integer coefficient equation demands m^(1-o(1)) solution-free sets against all nontrivial solutions. Behrend's convexity route handles special sign patterns but not arbitrary zero-sum-free partitions; no generic full-scope construction here.

All n,J require explicit Artin monomial basis of colon ideals. Need the actual f_J, staircase and ideal definitions; none appears completely in literal record. Dimension matching alone cannot prove spanning and independence for every J.

Primary v1 definitions and pp7-8 equivalent domination question read: find u,v whose union with common neighborhood dominates whenever delta>=n/2. Source only proves threshold2n/3-1, with obstructions just below1/2. Averaging common-neighborhood size does not establish domination; no bounded counterexample or uniform pair selection obtained.

For every alpha>0 produce a triangle-free 3D box graph with independence ratio<=alpha. Unbounded chromatic number alone is insufficient for independence ratio tending to zero; need a constructive amplification preserving boxes and triangle-freeness. No such full-scope route established.

For every fixed dimension d and epsilon>0, all sufficiently large Hasse diagrams need independent sets n^(1-epsilon). General triangle-free or unrestricted-dimension examples do not bridge this quantifier. No near-linear independent-set algorithm for fixed d identified.

Equality for every cube dimension depends on a(r-1) from an omitted construction and exact balanced-biindependence convention. Cannot screen extremality or parity endpoints from a symbol alone. Primary body not inspected; no invented definition or hypercube isoperimetric bridge.

All planar Delta>=5 require optimal linear-forest edge decomposition, including hard degree5-8 ranges. Degree bound supplies lower bound only; no reduction from Delta>=9. Would entail a difficult planar edge-coloring consequence; not a small certificate prospect.

Joint limits c->0,K->infinity of saddle transition states require precise energy, topology, parameter relation and minimax compactness. Circle geometry alone neither proves saddle selection nor L2 convergence. Definitions incomplete in record; no variational full-scope route.

One fixed polynomial must bound h^+(m) for all m. Finite cyclotomic computations cannot bound all class groups, and generic discriminant bounds are much larger. No uniform analytic class-number estimate of required strength.

Primary v4 Conjecture1.6 uses literal >=n iff n>10, while small dimensions include g1=1. Matrix[1] gives a trivial endpoint contradiction; no substantive discovery credit. Source theorem proves a lower bound for n>=11; difficult small-n upper bounds remain separate and were not solved here.
